description: Qwen3.5 Omni Flash is Qwen's fast multimodal model. We verified live support for text prompts, images, audio files, and direct video URLs on Alibaba's chat-completions-compatible API. Alibaba describes Flash as a fully evolved version of Qwen3 Omni with audio input support across 60+ languages.
name: Qwen3.5 Omni Flash
